title: Rod Cutting
description:
`prices[i]` is what a piece of length `i + 1` sells for. Cut a rod of length `n = prices.length` into any number of pieces and return the largest total price.

**Constraints**

- `1 <= prices.length <= 1000`
- `1 <= prices[i] <= 10^5`
hints: Unbounded knapsack: each length may be cut any number of times, so iterate lengths upwards.

editorial.explanation:
Unbounded knapsack: a piece of any length may be cut any number of times.

`best[length] = max(prices[cut - 1] + best[length - cut])` over every cut that fits. Iterating
lengths upwards is what allows reuse — the mirror image of the 0/1 knapsack's downward loop.

`O(n^2)` time, `O(n)` space.
